triggers.name: new_event
triggers.title: New event
triggers.description: New object event in Workfront secondary
triggers.help: Triggers immediately when the selected event occurs in Workfront. This trigger only supports a subset of objects; use new/updated object triggers for objects not found here. Note: Use Subscription filters to filter events server-side and reduce unnecessary job runs — avoid using Set trigger conditio…

input.name: webhook_object
input.label: Object
input.hint: Select an object from the list.

triggers.name: new_object
triggers.title: New record
triggers.description: New object created in Workfront secondary
triggers.help: This trigger pulls all user-specified objects from Workfront. First, define the object you want this recipe to listen for. Next, provide the conditions for your initial run by providing the earliest date-time to pull from Workfront.

input.name: ___poll_interval
input.label: Trigger poll interval
input.hint: How frequently to check for new events. Defaults to {{authUser.membership.poll_interval}} minutes if left blank. Minimum value allowed is {{authUser.membership.min_poll_interval}} minutes. Learn more …

input.name: object_type
input.label: Object
input.hint: Select the object in Workfront you want to work with.

input.name: custom_form
input.label: Custom form
input.hint: Choose which custom fields are returned with the Workfront object by selecting its parent custom form. Leave blank to return all custom fields

input.name: since
input.label: When first started, this recipe should pick up events from
input.hint: When you start a recipe for the first time, it picks up trigger events from this specified date and time. Leave empty to get records created one hour ago. Once a recipe has been run ortested, value ca…

input.name: sort_attr
input.label: Sort attribute
input.hint: Select the attribute which corresponds to the creation time of this record. Default value is entryDate.

actions.name: __adhoc_http_action
actions.title: Custom action
actions.help: Build your own Workfront action. The request will be authorized under your Workfront connection.

input.name: mnemonic
input.label: Action name
input.hint: Give this action you're building a descriptive name, e.g. create record, get record

input.name: verb
input.label: Method
input.hint: Select HTTP method of the request

actions.name: create_object
actions.title: Create record
actions.help: Creates a new object in Workfront. Select the object you would like to create and more input fields will be dynamically generated for you to map datapills to.

input.name: object_type
input.label: Object
input.hint: Select the object in Workfront you want to work with.

input.name: custom_form
input.label: Custom form
input.hint: To associate custom forms to object, select from the picklist. All fields will be displayed by default if user doesnt select any form.

actions.name: download_document
actions.title: Download document
actions.help: Retrieve the content of a specific document in workfront. This content can be used to upload the attachment into another application in subsequent recipe steps.

input.name: id
input.label: Document ID
input.hint: Specify the document ID to download.

input.name: chunk_size
input.label: Chunk size (KB)
input.hint: Configure this to optimize throughput. Larger chunk size will increase throughput, but may hit API limit. Default to 1024 KB. Learn more

input.name: encoding
input.label: Encoding of the file content
input.hint: Specify the encoding of the file to set it explicitly. By default, encoding will be set to UTF-8 if left blank. Click here to know more about the different encodings supported.

actions.name: search_objects
actions.title: Search records
actions.help: Searches for objects in Workfront and returns an array of records which you can use in subsequent steps in your recipe. Allows you to write your own Workfront query or use a query builder. If Filter condition is entered, value from any other optional field will not be considered.

input.name: object_type
input.label: Object
input.hint: Select the object in Workfront you want to work with.

input.name: custom_form
input.label: Custom form
input.hint: Choose which custom fields are returned with the Workfront object by selecting its parent custom form. Leave blank to return all custom fields

actions.name: update_object
actions.title: Update record
actions.help: Updates a specific object in Workfront based on input from the recipe. Updates in Workfront are sparse - only inputs fields with values will update the field for that object.

input.name: object_type
input.label: Object
input.hint: Select the object in Workfront you want to work with.

input.name: custom_form
input.label: Custom form
input.hint: To associate custom forms to object, select from the picklist. All fields will be displayed by default if user doesnt select any form.

actions.name: upload_document
actions.title: Upload document
actions.help: Upload file into workfront project via file contents.

input.name: docObjCode
input.label: Object
input.hint: Select the object to which you want to upload the document.

input.name: objID
input.label: Object ID
input.hint: The object ID to which you want to upload the document.

input.name: name
input.label: File name
input.hint: Specify the file name with extension for the document. E.g. filename.csv

input.name: description
input.label: Description
input.hint: Specify the description for the document.

input.name: file_content
input.label: File content
input.hint: File contents to upload in bytes.
